description:
Run holdout confirmation for an approved private zero-copy integration through existing abstractions, or publish the final no-change verdict.

## Background

Only a qualifying private integration receives before/after measurement. A public-API or shared-infrastructure requirement is already a terminal no-adoption outcome and receives no implementation or timed confirmation in this story. Private-route confirmation includes copying, offset handling, masking, dispatch, setup, and output costs in the same whole-consumer boundary used by the prototype.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Any adopted private integration has paired or interleaved holdout samples against the pinned pre-change baseline with adjusted confidence bounds and equivalence-margin results.
- [hard] REQ-02: Whole-consumer benefit survives all adapter costs and semantic checks; otherwise the integration is not accepted and the contradictory evidence remains committed.
- [hard] REQ-03: The receipt pins contract, addendum, executable, configuration, inputs, runtime provenance, profiles, and exact commands by content identity, while any no-adoption path records why no after measurement is applicable.
- [hard] REQ-04: A public/shared requirement produces no timed samples in this issue and remains only a pending owner decision for a separately authorized container.

## Notes

Run private-route confirmation only in the benchmark window on the prepared host under the full-host wrapper.
title: Confirm the private zero-copy production outcome
